Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 e_lock EXCEPTION;
 PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(e_lock, -00054);
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id is not null then
 begin
 select nvl(min_temp,0), nvl(max_temp,0)
 into :min_temp, :max_temp
 from batch_inputs
 where batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id 
 and substr(batch_id,8,2) = 'CB' 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and qc_date is null
 and not exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM units
 WHERE batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 AND nvl(warehouse_id,'XX') != :GLOBAL.warehouse)
 and exists (select 'x' -- Added by Kishore on 03/27/2013. SCR 12096
 from units 
 where batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id 
 and nvl(qc_checkin_flag, 'X') != 'Y' 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)
 for update of batch_id nowait; 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 :min_temp := '';
 :max_temp := '';
 show_error('1130');
 WHEN e_lock then
 show_error('0292');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :GLOBAL.last_unit_number
 from units
 where batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id ;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 else
 :GLOBAL.last_unit_number := 0;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_bt number;
 temp_bst date;
 temp_sbt number;
 temp_fbt number;
 attrb_grp varchar2(5);
 temp_pher varchar2(1);
 cursor c1 is SELECT attrib_group 
 FROM unit_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_pher := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 begin
 --
 /* chapter_id clause is being removed from this
 place because testing instruments cannot handle same
 Unit IDs from different chapters */
 --
 select batch_id, donor_decision_code, coll_date
 into temp_batch_id, temp_donor_decision_code, :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;

 if temp_batch_id is not null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0040');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if temp_donor_decision_code = 'A'
 then
 :s_cue_desc := 'Ambiguous';
 end if;
 if temp_donor_decision_code = 'S'
 then
 :s_cue_desc := 'Autologous';
 end if;
 if temp_donor_decision_code = 'T'
 then
 :s_cue_desc := 'Therapeutic';
 end if;
 if temp_donor_decision_code = 'N'
 then
 :s_cue_desc := 'NFT';
 end if;
 if temp_donor_decision_code = 'Y'
 then
 :s_cue_desc := 'OK';
 end if;
 if temp_donor_decision_code = 'O'
 then
 :s_cue_desc := 'No Cue';
 end if;
 if temp_donor_decision_code = 'X'
 then
 :s_cue_desc := 'N/A';
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0160');
 check_package_failure;
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 if :GLOBAL.seq_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
 show_error('0179');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'N';
 end if;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

/*To retrieve the drive id, name, and bleed times for each unit entered in this batch*/
BEGIN
 for c1rec in c1
 loop
 if c1rec.attrib_group = 'PHER' then
 temp_pher := 'Y';
 end if;
 end loop;
END;
begin
 select units.drive_id, site_name,
 round((bleed_end_time - bleed_start_time) * 60* 24), --For bleed time in no of minutes
 slow_bleed_time, max_bleed_time
 into :ctrl_blk_2.drive_id,:ctrl_blk_2.drive_name,
 temp_bt, temp_sbt, temp_fbt
 from units, group_sites, drives_lab dl, chapters --- LT 2018
 where units.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 and units.drive_id = dl.drive_id
 and group_sites.group_site_id = dl.group_site_id
 and units.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and group_sites.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and dl.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and chapters.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 IF temp_pher != 'Y' THEN
 if temp_bt BETWEEN temp_sbt AND temp_fbt
 then
 show_error('9211');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif temp_bt > temp_fbt
 then
 show_error('9001');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;


 END IF;
exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 go_block('units');
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 message('This unit belongs to more than one drive.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from temp_units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id ;
 if temp_count= 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag := 'N';
 else
 if temp_count = 1
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0170');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_donor_decision_code in ('N','A','O','T')
 then
 :GLOBAL.pop_error_field_left := 'ctrl_blk_2.unit_id';
 pop_error('8011');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_catalog_no VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
 sZLotPos NUMBER:=0;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :s_catalog_number := upper(:s_catalog_number);
 
 
 --This procedure validates the concatenated scan of catalog number and lot number.
 -- Check data identifiers
 
 IF :s_catalog_number!='M' then 
 
 
 IF substr(:s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND -- catalog number (scanninng with the container ID)
 substr( :s_catalog_number, 13, 2 ) = '&)' THEN -- lot number identifier
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,1,12), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else
 :catalog_number := substr(temp_catalog_no,2);
 :s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,13);
 End If;
 
 ELSIF substr(:s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND substr( :s_catalog_number, 12, 2 ) = '&)' then -- for catalog number without continer ID 
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,1,11), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else
 :catalog_number := temp_catalog_no;
 :s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,12);
 End If;
 
 ELSE -- catalog scan only 
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(:s_catalog_number, temp_catalog_no);
 If form_failure then
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= '';
 ---:s_bag_code_desc := '';
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 if length(temp_catalog_no)=10 then
 :catalog_number :=substr(temp_catalog_no,2);
 else
 :catalog_number :=temp_catalog_no; 
 end if;
 
 END IF; 
END IF;

 
END;

 validate_catalog_no_scan_isbt(:s_catalog_number,temp_catalog_no);
 if form_failure
 then
 :s_catalog_number := '';

 ---:s_bag_code_desc := '';
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 :catalog_number := temp_catalog_no;

declare

begin

 end if;
 
 select catalog_number into tmp_catalog_no
 from valid_catalogs
 where catalog_number = :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id 
 --and code = :bag_code
 --and NVL(length(code), 0) = decode(:GLOBAL.code_scheme,'I',3,'C',2) -- diptiia commented for SCR 823 - to remove 3 digit length restriction
 --and code != '99'
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+365);
 
 
 exception

 -- :s_bag_code_desc := '';
 :lot_number := '';

 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_lot_number VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_purple_tube_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_prog_name VARCHAR2(8);
 v_local_time date;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 savepoint all_clear;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id is null
 then
 generate_batch_id;
 begin
 insert into batch_inputs
 (batch_id,chapter_id,contract_id,
 min_temp,max_temp,checkin_user_id, insert_dats)
 values
 (:ctrl_blk_1.batch_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,'INTERNAL',
 :min_temp,:max_temp, :banner.user_id,sysdate);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 
 -- Added on 02/16/2011; Timezone conversions code; --- tmppp
 --declare
 -- v_local_time date;
 -- begin
 -- if is_timezone_enabled then
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 -- :banner.hdr_date := v_local_time;
 -- else
 -- :banner.hdr_date := sysdate;
 --end if;
 -- end;
 ---------- 
 if v_local_time is null then
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 update units
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id,
 catalog_number=:ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number,
 --bag_code = :bag_code,
 bag_check_in_dats = v_local_time, --sysdate, -- tmppp
 lot_number = :lot_number,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 --
 -- Note that chapter_id is not updated here; It will
 -- be done only when the CUE is checked in. Please do
 -- not put the chapter_id back here because you
 -- will have problems in unit_interdictions from tests
 -- that come between when the unit was not checked in
 -- and those thast come when the bag was checked in
 -- but not the CUE.
 --
 begin
 insert into units
 (warehouse_id, unit_id,chk_digit,catalog_number,lot_number,batch_id,chapter_id,
 received_date, bag_check_in_dats,insert_dats,program_id)
 values (:GLOBAL.warehouse, :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,substr(:ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit,-1),:ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number,
 :lot_number, :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id,:global.chapter_id,
 trunc(sysdate), v_local_time, sysdate,
 :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('4');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 post;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
 select red_tube_flag, purple_tube_flag,
 :banner.prog_name
 into temp_red_tube_flag, temp_purple_tube_flag,
 temp_prog_name
 from temp_units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id ;
 -- message('Red Tube: '||temp_red_tube_flag);
 -- message('Purple Tube: '||temp_purple_tube_flag);
 -- message('Program Name: '||temp_prog_name);
 begin
 update units
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 (red_tube_flag,purple_tube_flag,
 serum_plasma_ind,red_tube2, program_id) =
 (select red_tube_flag, purple_tube_flag,
 purple_tube2_flag, red_tube2,
 :banner.prog_name
 from temp_units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('5');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 delete from temp_units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('6');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 temp_d_date date;
 temp_return_val varchar2(1);
 v_local_time date;
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/23/2011. IM 5617
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 :GLOBAL.previous_catalog_no := :catalog_number;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 --- message('slot='||:s_lot_number||'lot='||:lot_number||' cata='||:catalog_number||' string='||:s_catalog_number);pause;
 
 begin
 select nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) 
 into temp_d_date
 from valid_lots
 where lot_number = :lot_number
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and catalog_number = :catalog_number
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_Time+100);
 --and v_local_time >= eff_date; -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/23/2011. IM 5617
 
 IF temp_d_date <= v_local_time THEN -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/23/2011. IM 5617
 -- :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_BATCH_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure generate_batch_id is

batch_type VARCHAR2(20);
batch_id VARCHAR2(4);
v_sysdate date;
v_local_time date;

begin
 
 -- time zone change --5/5/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 batch_type := 'BATCH_ID';
 generate_sequence (batch_type, batch_id);
 :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id := to_char(v_sysdate,'MMDDYY')||'-CB'||
 batch_id;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_COLL_ID_085
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--This procedure validates Collection centers as per Code128 format 

PROCEDURE VALIDATE_COLL_ID_085( p_coll_id in varchar2)
 IS
 temp_c_coll_id VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_c_chapter_id VARCHAR2(5) :=name_in('Global.chapter_id');
BEGIN
 SELECT distinct coll_id
 INTO temp_c_coll_id 
 FROM valid_collection_agencies
 WHERE coll_id = P_coll_id
 --AND Contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 AND contract_id = nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.man_contract_id,contract_id)
 AND chapter_id = temp_c_chapter_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date 
 AND NVL(term_date, sysdate + 365);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('9712');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
END;
